title: AgentsStep
description: agents.step@1 (one agent system, 2026-11-12): one entry of a run's append-only step log, as GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/steps returns it and as agents.step.appended@1 publishes it. SEQ is the run's own order (1, 2, …), never renumbered; a reader pages with ?after=SEQ. KIND says what the entry is: think (a plan, a check, a note to self), tool (a tool call or its result), message (words for the person), approval (the run asked), child (a sub-agent or a hand-off) or file (a file the run made). TEXT is what a person reads; TOOL_CALL is the tool's name and input on a tool entry; RESULT is what came back. The product's own event may split a call and its result into two steps: both carry KIND tool and the call's seq is the earlier one. A step carries no credential, no key and no token; a secret a tool saw is redacted before it is stored.

run_id.description: The run this step belongs to (agents.run@1's id).

seq.description: The run's own order for this entry, starting at 1 and never renumbered. ?after=SEQ reads the entries after it.

kind.description: think: a plan, a check or reasoning. tool: a tool call or its result. message: words for the person. approval: the run asked its person. child: a sub-agent run or a hand-off. file: a file the run made.

text.description: What a person reads for this step: the plan line, the message, the short tool answer or the file's name. Never a prompt or a secret.

tool_call.description: The tool this entry called. On a product that logs a call and its result as two steps, the call names the tool and the result entry has no TOOL_CALL.

input.description: The call's input, as the product recorded it: an object, a short summary string, or null. Credential-shaped fields are already redacted.

result.description: What the step answered: a tool's output, a check's verdict, a file's reference. Any JSON; never a credential.

cost.description: What this step spent, when the product meters per step. Null when it meters per run only.

ended_at.description: When the step ended, when the product records an end. A product that logs a point event sets it to the event's time; null when the step is still open.

child_run.description: The child run this step started, on KIND child. Null elsewhere.
